description: Use this when you need the content of many pages from one website, such as a docs section or a blog: it follows links from a start URL and scrapes each page it finds, up to `max_pages`. Waits up to `wait_for_completion_seconds` (default 45) and returns the pages if the crawl finishes in that time; otherwise returns a crawl_id to pass to get_crawl_results (not get_batch_results). For a known list of URLs use batch_scrape_urls; for one page use scrape_website.

country.description: Optional country code for location-specific crawling.

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl. Set to 1 to scrape only the start URL.

parser.description: Optional parser ID for specialized content extraction.

wait_for_completion_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the crawl to finish and return its pages in this call. 0 returns the crawl_id right away.

name: create_crawl
title: Create Crawl
